keeps.name: Poplar Point Campground (Jordan Lake SRA)
keeps.waterfront_evidence: Poplar Point alone (split 2026-10-22): ReserveAmerica per-site 'Distance to Body of Water' is 50 ft for 131 of its 573 drive-in sites, spread over every loop (B 20, C 13, E 27, F 16, G 19, H 14, J 22); NC911 leaf-off imagery (2025-02) at 35.7199,-79.0139 shows a Loop E pad with an RV ~20 m from Jordan Lake across scattered pines, no road or day-use strip between. The official campground map draws Loops B-J along the shoreline. Pool 216 ft (66 m), campground ~87 m, dam far downstream. Agrees with AWH's firsthand 'Many lakefront campsites.'
keeps.inclusion_evidence: ncparks.gov Jordan Lake camping page (read 2026-10-22): 'Poplar Point offers 579 sites for RV, tent and trailer camping; 363 sites have electric and water hookups', showers and dump station; ReserveAmerica 552903 lists 573 drive-in Poplar Point sites in Loops B-J, site-detail driveway lengths 23-136 ft.

adds.name: Crosswinds Campground (Jordan Lake SRA)
adds.note: Three wooded areas on a point of Jordan Lake off Farrington Road, just north of US 64, with a swim beach between Areas B and C. --Claude
adds.inclusion_evidence: ncparks.gov Jordan Lake camping page (read 2026-10-22): 'Crosswinds offers 182 campsites for recreational vehicles, tent and trailer camping; 134 sites have electric and water hookups', showers and dump station; ReserveAmerica 552903 lists 103 drive-in Crosswinds sites (Area A non-electric, Areas B and C 50-amp electric), site-detail driveway lengths 55-146 ft.
adds.waterfront_evidence: ReserveAmerica per-site 'Distance to Body of Water': nearest B055 and C033 at 100 ft, the rest 150 ft or more (Area A 200+); the official campground map puts both of those well back from the shore. NC911 leaf-off imagery (2025-02) at 35.7468,-78.9930 shows the Area C loop 30-60 m from the lake behind a continuous pine/hardwood belt. No pad within the on-water bound and no confirmed sightline -> not waterfront.

adds.name: Parkers Creek Campground (Jordan Lake SRA)
adds.note: Four loops strung north along the east shore of Jordan Lake from US 64, with a swim beach and boat ramp at the campground. The waterside sites are mostly in Loop 2, on its own point. --Claude
adds.inclusion_evidence: ncparks.gov Jordan Lake camping page (read 2026-10-22): 'Parkers Creek offers 250 sites for RV, tent and trailer camping; 120 sites have electric and water hookups', showers and dump station; ReserveAmerica 552903 lists 247 Parkers Creek sites in Loops 1, 2, 3, 4 North and 4 South (30-amp electric in each), 246 marked drive-in, site-detail driveway lengths 32-116 ft.
adds.waterfront_evidence: ReserveAmerica per-site 'Distance to Body of Water': Loop 2 sites 060, 062, 085 at 15 ft and 059, 072, 074, 077, 078 at 30 ft (15 of its 33 sites within 50 ft); Loop 1 sites 025, 027, 028 at 30 ft; Loop 3 113, 114 at 30 ft; Loop 4 North 201, 203 at 30 ft. The official campground map's Loop 2 inset draws sites 58-63 and 72-79 on the shoreline. NC911 leaf-off imagery (2025-02) at 35.7468,-79.0348 is pine-canopy-blind over the Loop 2 point but shows no road, lot or day-use strip between the loop and the water, so it does not veto the per-site data.

adds.name: Vista Point RV Campground (Jordan Lake SRA)
adds.note: Two rows of RV sites in the woods at the end of North Pea Ridge Road, back from the lake, near the Vista Point boat ramp, sailboat launch and swim beach. NC Parks lists it as group RV camping under its group cancellation policy, while ReserveAmerica sells the sites one at a time. --Claude
adds.inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica 552903 (read 2026-10-22): 'Vista Point RV Group Campground', 49 sites, each 'Campsite Electric', Site Reserve Type Site-Specific, Capacity/Size Rating Single, Drive-In back-in, driveway 50 ft, max vehicle 40 ft, 30-amp electric and water; ncparks.gov camping page: 'Vista Point offers 50 campsites for group RV camping. All sites contain electric and water hookups' (group cancellation policy). AWH 2026-10-22: individually bookable sites qualify.
adds.waterfront_evidence: Official Vista Point campground map draws the RV sites as two rows in an inland block north of the entrance road, set back from both coves. ReserveAmerica gives all 49 sites the same 'Distance to Body of Water' of 100 ft, an evident default. NC911 leaf-off imagery (2025-02) at 35.7068,-79.0508 shows the north ends of both rows ~85 m from the lake behind continuous pine woods. No pad within the on-water bound and no sightline -> not waterfront.

excluded.name: Vista Point Group Camp / Parkers Creek group sites
excluded.reason: Group tent camping only (five and six sites, up to 35 people).

excluded.reason: Walk-in backpack camping: '24 campsites nestled in the woods ... from 100 yard to a half mile from the parking lot', walk-up only.
